text: POST /tasks's three refusals are one function, admission, which Nagini proves in place: a request from another site gets 403, one for an engine the service doesn't know 400, a second statue while one is queued or generating 409, and 0 admits the rest. create_task calls it under tasks_lock and raises the same errors, so the service answers every request as before. The statue model's exploration records every call of it, on admitted and refused requests alike, and the gate checks each call against the contract. server.py ships Invariant's stand-in for Nagini's contract library beside it, whose calls do nothing when the service runs. @gitdek approved shaping this code for a proof on 2026-11-12, as a single exception to checking code as it stands.
